_meta.note: PATTERNS ONLY. No markup, copy, asset, SVG or shader is lifted from the reference. Every number below is a count or a distribution over measured computed styles.
_meta.ratification_note: ratified: false. Fields in _unmeasured are absent, not defaulted — four of them are required by design_system.load_benchmark, so this file does not load until an operator declares them. That is the gate, not a bug.

page_selection_rationale.about-us: ABOUT, TEAM, section rhythm at its most generous
page_selection_rationale.home: HERO, NAV, FOOTER, CTA, LOGO-BAR, display type scale

elements_measured.definition: renderedDOM_elements and text_nodes are summed across pages and counted separately; neither includes the other. renderedDOM is capped per page by MAX_DOM_ELEMENTS in extract-reference.js, so renderedDOM_elements <= pages * per_page_dom_cap by construction.

ratification.note: Fields under `overrides` are OPERATOR DECLARATIONS, not measurements. `_source` provenance is not written for them: a declared value that claimed a measured provenance would be fabrication with a citation.

_source.bg_primary: bvnk.com opaque background covering the most painted area, 53917308px^2 over 10 elements
_source.text_primary: bvnk.com text colour, 190 occurrences, 13.98:1 on bg_primary
_source.text_muted: bvnk.com secondary text colour, 14 occurrences, 7.34:1 on bg_primary
_source.surface: bvnk.com background on radius>=4px elements, 15 elements, 12.98:1 with text_primary
_source.bg_secondary: bvnk.com banding background, 12 elements, 1.14:1 step from bg_primary, 12.29:1 with text_primary
_source.border: bvnk.com measured borderColor on borderWidth>0, 13 elements, 1.29:1 from bg_primary (separator range)
_source._border_emphasis_excluded: #242d35 measured on 13 elements is an emphasis outline, not a separator; excluded from the border role

_source.heading_sizes_px: every distinct heading fontSize measured on bvnk.com; see _distributions.heading_sizes_px for occurrence counts. No outlier is excluded here — exclusion is a ratification act.

_source.section_py_px: modal full-width block padding on bvnk.com: 180px on 19 blocks; runner-up 120px on 12. The modal value can be hero-specific top padding rather than the section default — see _distributions.section_py_px and decide at ratification.
